# Miami Yacht Collective

> Private yacht charter company in Miami, Florida. Hand-picked fleet of 9 vessels ranging from 25 ft to 90 ft. Available 24/7 for sunset cruises, birthday parties, bachelorette events, corporate charters, and full-day group experiences on Biscayne Bay and the open Atlantic. Direct line to the captain — no third-party platforms, no booking fees.

## Business Information

- Name: Miami Yacht Collective
- Address: 668 NW N River Dr, Miami, FL 33136
- Phone: (787) 664-5040
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/17876645040
- Email: sebastian@mcaiconsulting.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/miamiyachtcollective/
- Hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Departures: From the Miami River dock, 10 minutes from Brickell and 15 minutes from Miami Beach
- Service area: Miami, Miami Beach, Biscayne Bay, Star Island, Fisher Island, Stiltsville, and offshore Atlantic itineraries

## Fleet (9 vessels)

- 90' Deep Blue with Jacuzzi — from $4,999 / 4 hrs
- 75' Ferretti Italian Motor Yacht — from $3,000 / 4 hrs
- 65' Azimut L'chaim — from $3,000 / 4 hrs
- 62' Anvera — from $1,700 / 4 hrs
- 55' Azimut — from $1,600 / 4 hrs
- 48' Isabella with Jet Ski — from $1,499 / 4 hrs
- 46' Maxum — from $1,000 / 4 hrs
- 28' Axopar Brabus Edition Sport Boat — from $1,200 / 4 hrs
- 25' Yamaha 255XD Jet Boat — from $1,000 / 4 hrs

All charters are 4 hours and include licensed captain and crew. Prices are the same on every date of the year, including holidays and event weeks. Children are welcome and children's life jackets are on board. Commercial photo and video shoots and wedding ceremonies on board are welcome. The team books in English and Spanish. Charters depart from 668 NW N River Dr on the Miami River.

## Common Use Cases

- Sunset cruises (most popular)
- Birthday celebrations on the water
- Bachelorette and bachelor parties
- Corporate events and team outings
- Anchor and swim at Nixon's Sandbar
- Day trips to Stiltsville
- Photoshoots and content production
- Sport boat day with watersports (Axopar)
- Group celebrations on the 90' Deep Blue
- Star Island and celebrity homes sightseeing on a private yacht
- Family days (children welcome, children's life jackets on board)
- Weddings, elopements and vow renewals (ceremonies on board welcome)
- Quinceañeras and sweet sixteens
- Commercial and personal photo and video shoots
- Pre-cruise and post-cruise days for PortMiami passengers
- Event weeks: Art Basel, New Year's Eve, spring break / Miami Music Week / Ultra, Miami Grand Prix (same prices as any other week)

## How to Book

Most charters are confirmed in under 10 minutes by phone or WhatsApp. The team checks availability live, matches the right yacht to the group size and event type, and holds the date before the call ends. No web form, no platforms, no broker markup.

- Call: (787) 664-5040
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/17876645040

Lines are open 24 hours, 7 days a week.
